requirements.requirement: The system must return an HTTP 200 response when an insufficiency condition is detected and successfully handled.
The system must include the insufficiency response payload defined in EVAL-FAILSAFE-S1 in the API response body.
The system must not include a score field in the API response when insufficiency is detected.
The system must preserve JSON schema compatibility with existing frontend chat consumers when returning insufficiency responses.
The system must include a user-facing message field in the response suitable for direct display in chat.
The system must include valid_measure_count in the API response when insufficiency is detected.
The system must include required_minimum with value 3 in the API response when insufficiency is detected.
The system must include missing_measure_types in the API response when insufficiency is detected.
The system must route insufficiency responses from the EvaluateCare facade to the FastAPI layer without transformation loss.
The system must ensure content-type application/json is set on insufficiency responses.
The system must generate a natural language explanation in the message field that clearly states insufficient data without implying a score.
The system must avoid speculative or inferred scoring language in insufficiency responses.
The system must produce consistent insufficiency phrasing across provider and clinical trial contexts.
The system must ensure the message field is concise and under 300 characters for chat compatibility.
The system must not include technical internal field names in the user-facing message.
The system must produce deterministic insufficiency messages for identical inputs.
The system must gracefully handle null or malformed facade responses by returning an HTTP 500 with a structured error payload.
The system must return an HTTP 422 response when request validation fails before reaching the facade.
The system must log insufficiency responses at the API layer for observability without exposing logs to the client.
The system must ensure the API response structure remains backward compatible with existing FastAPI response models.
